Self-hosted OCR assets. No paid OCR endpoint is called.
Tesseract.js 6.0.1: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0)
Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core (Apache-2.0)
Korean and English models: @tesseract.js-data/kor and @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int.
Model source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best (Apache-2.0)
Do not omit lang/*.traineddata.gz or worker/core files when uploading.
